QorCap v0.3.37: challenge card press feedback

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged. Referee verification is unchanged.

- [#113](https://github.com/ConWan30/qorcap/pull/113): the live challenge card reads each press from `/status` `input.recent_presses` (newest 64 rising edges, on the same clock the referee reads from `inputs.jsonl`), so a short tap is no longer missed between polls. The card follows the referee rule: OPTIONS, then exactly the pattern as the next presses. An extra or wrong press, including a rolled d-pad, resets the count and the card says so. Once the pattern is complete, later presses are not counted. Each press shows `Got X. Next: Y.` or `Extra X: not counted. Redo OPTIONS + all at next snap.` Before this, the card skipped stray presses and could show PASS for a sequence the referee rejects. Display only; nothing new goes into the bundle.
